items.title: Ashley Keating and Allan Whitworth Interview, 1963-03-22
items.q: The personnel at the time that Alan and I left consisted of ... Alex Jolliffe trombone ... myself banjo

ctx.x: Who's in the band? The personnel at the time that Alan and I left consisted of Mike Hawthorne trumpet, Alex Jolliffe trombone, Martin Mooney clarinet, myself banjo, Alan drums, Tony McArthur bass, and Rod Byrne piano. No. Uh, well,
did, uh, you say Lewis Johnson, did any other bands have any influence on the band as a group?
